# Amber Framework

Amber is a productive, type-safe web framework for Crystal. The supported V2
beta path is a server-rendered web application generated by Amber CLI.

## Canonical machine-readable sources

- Complete V2 documentation bundle: https://amberframework.org/docs/v2/knowledge.md
- Documentation Markdown by page: https://amberframework.org/docs/v2/{path}.md
- Documentation JSON by page: https://amberframework.org/docs/v2/{path}.json
- Read-only MCP endpoint: https://amberframework.org/mcp
- Blog Markdown index: https://amberframework.org/blog.md
- Blog JSON index: https://amberframework.org/blog.json
- Blog RSS feed: https://amberframework.org/blog/feed.xml
- Amber's Way JSON: https://amberframework.org/amber-way.json
- Amber's Way Markdown: https://amberframework.org/amber-way.md

## Primary pages

- Home: https://amberframework.org/index.md
- Installation: https://amberframework.org/docs/v2/getting-started/installation.md
- First application: https://amberframework.org/docs/v2/getting-started.md
- Web template: https://amberframework.org/docs/v2/guides/web-template.md
- WebSockets: https://amberframework.org/docs/v2/guides/websockets.md
- Background jobs: https://amberframework.org/docs/v2/guides/background-jobs.md
- Performance evidence: https://amberframework.org/docs/v2/guides/performance.md
- Actual website and WebSocket evidence: https://amberframework.org/benchmarks/amber-v2-site-websocket-2026-08-11.json

Use V2 pages for V2 questions. Preserve exact file-placement instructions,
supported-versus-preview labels, tested versions, and benchmark boundaries.
